mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trading_price_history (stock_code, interval_type, trade_datetime, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume) VALUES (#{stockCode}, #{intervalType}, #{tradeDateTime}, #{open}, #{high}, #{low}, #{close}, #{volume}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE open_price = VALUES(open_price), high_price = VALUES(high_price), low_price = VALUES(low_price), close_price = VALUES(close_price), volume = VALUES(volume), deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
